verdict.rationale: Firebase exposes broad programmatic surfaces — Admin SDKs, a scriptable CLI (firebase-tools, verified headless via npx), and a first-party MCP server that lets AI agents manage projects, Auth users, and Firestore data (firebase-docs-12/20, firebase-probe-5/6) — covering most console actions. However there's no unified OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (firebase-probe-1/2 both 404), and some capabilities (e.g., security rules editing, MongoDB-compatible API, console-only Gemini insights) are split across disparate tools rather than a single consistent API, so parity is good but not seamless or fully documented.
